title: DORA Threat-Led Penetration Testing (TLPT) Record
description: Schema for the TLPT determination + record mandated by DORA Art.26-27 and Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/1190 (RTS specifying TLPT). TLPT (TIBER-EU aligned) is mandatory at least every 3 years ONLY for financial entities the competent authority identifies as significant for TLPT purposes (DORA Art.26(8) / RTS 2025/1190). This record therefore FIRST documents the entity's in-scope determination (in_scope) and, when in_scope==true, the actual TLPT engagement evidence. The applicability determination is itself the honest control: a documented out-of-scope rationale is EVIDENCE-ONLY (not a fabricated compliance pass), and an in-scope-but-not-yet-conducted entity HONESTLY FAILs.

entity.description: The entity to which the TLPT determination applies.

classification.description: Entity classification relevant to TLPT scoping, e.g. 'ICT third-party service provider', 'significant credit institution'.

in_scope.description: True iff the competent authority has identified this entity as significant for TLPT purposes (DORA Art.26(8)). TLPT is mandatory only when true.

scope_rationale.description: Documented determination of why the entity is / is not in scope. Mandatory in BOTH cases so the out-of-scope determination is itself auditable evidence, not a silent skip.

tlpt.description: The actual TLPT engagement record. Required content only when in_scope==true; left null / pending until a real test is conducted (do NOT fabricate).

test_date.description: ISO-8601 date the TLPT (active red-team phase) completed.

external_testers.description: True iff the test was performed by external testers meeting RTS 2025/1190 requirements (DORA Art.27).

authority_signoff.description: True iff the competent authority validated the scope / issued the attestation of TLPT completion (DORA Art.26(6)-(7)).
